name: Burning Blade Coven
summary: In the northern cliffs of the Valley of Trials, the Burning Blade Coven threatens new Horde recruits. Cultists and summoned demons haunt the old mineral caves, using them to practice dark magic on Durotar’s doorstep.

sections.title: A Shadow Over the Proving Grounds
sections.body: Dark rituals now trouble the caves along the Valley of Trials’ northern edge. Imps and lesser fiends spill from the cavern mouth, stirring chaos among the young orcs and Darkspear trolls training here for the Horde. Yarrog Baneshadow leads the Burning Blade cult from deep inside the caves. What was once a testing wilderness is now a battleground against demonic corruption.

sections.title: Corruption in the Rocks
sections.body:
Before demons took root, local overseers hoped to harvest the caves’ raw materials for the settlement. Foreman Thazz'ril went inside to survey the minerals, but cultists drove him out in haste, leaving valuable equipment behind.

Now, driving Baneshadow’s coven from the caves is the final proving trial for aspiring warriors, rogues, and spellcasters before they venture into greater Durotar.

faq.q: Where is the Burning Blade Coven located?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade Coven occupies caves in the high red rock ridges along the Valley of Trials’ northern edge in Durotar.
The warlock Yarrog Baneshadow leads the coven, directs its rituals, and commands its summoned demons.

faq.q: What kinds of enemies lurk inside?
aliases: what mobs are in the cave
faq.answer: The caves hold rogue imps, minor demonic servitors, and mortal acolytes aligned with the Burning Blade cult.

faq.q: Why do new recruits go into the cave?
faq.answer: New orc and troll adventurers brave the cave’s depths to recover lost tools such as Foreman Thazz'ril's pick. They also slay Yarrog Baneshadow as their final initiation rite before leaving the valley.

angles.text: As a warlock, you see an early warning in the demonic imps and dark rituals here, where fel power is wielded recklessly.
As an orc, you can see the Burning Blade cult near the Valley of Trials as an intolerable insult to Thrall's new Horde. Their presence recalls the demon worship the orcs fought to leave behind.
